fields.what_it_is: Vertu Stand-Alone, No Profile ACDF With Ti-Bond® Titanium Porous Coating. Advanced Design. Simplified Technique. Controlled Implant Placement. Advanced Locking Screw Technology. Multiple Footprint Options for Maximum Stability. Balanced Lag Screw Design for Graft Compression. Ti-Bond Titanium Porous Coating: Immediate Stability, Increased Surface Topography, Hydrophilic Properties. Microstructure: The porous titanium creates a microstructure that increases surface area of bony contact. Ti-Bond Titanium Porous Coating: Random, unconnected pores.
